title: Manufacturing Plant Manager
text:
**ClarkDietrich** offers a comprehensive lineup of products and services for both cold-formed steel framing and drywall/plastering finishing systems. We manufacture innovative products for interior and exterior framing, interior and exterior finishing, floor and roof framing, clips, connectors, metal lath, welded wire, barrier mesh, and accessories.

As the demands for higher performance in all aspects of today's building requirements rise, our leadership team's partnerships are focused on maintaning the highest quality standards in the commercial building industry. Our teams work with architects, engineers, building developers and owners, contractors, and more on projects of all sizes, scopes, and complexity. Far beyond products, our collaborations increasingly involve efforts and expertise that support a more ingenious installation and design. Are you a Leader that understands collaboration, trust and engagement? We are looking for incredible people to contribute to our future success and growth!

Join a team that is **STRONGER THAN STEEL**℠, by applying to become a **Manufacturing Plant Manager** at our **Woodland** location.

**SUMMARY**

The **Plant Manager** is responsible for the day-to-day operations of the entire manufacturing facility to include safety, quality, efficiencies, and meeting customer expectations. This includes driving strategic plans that ensure that production goals are met in the safest and most cost-effective manner, while delivering expected financial results.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Direct and manage plant operations for production, maintenance, quality, and shipping and receiving.
* Coordinate plant activities through planning with departmental supervisors/managers to ensure that all manufacturing objectives are accomplished in a timely and cost-effective manner.
* Oversee all aspects of the day-to-day plant operations, including production, maintenance, and logistics.
* Develop, monitor and control plant budget, through active planning and understanding of P&L to ensure financial targets are met.
* Understands employment laws and oversees the application of SOPs, policies and procedures.
* Implements cost effective systems of control over capital, operating expenditures, manpower, wages, and salaries.
* Leads the effort and drives Lean Manufacturing tools and techniques fostering continuous improvement within the facility. Acts in a proactive fashion regarding problem resolution.
* Maintains existing plant facilities and equipment; replace or adjust plant facilities and equipment when necessary. Investigate and recommend new equipment or process improvements.
* Actively participated with Regional Sales Management to develop and manage the Regional Operating Unit into a team-oriented environment.
* Establish and monitor overall plant performance for production and quality standards.
* Controls and minimizes labor overtime, premium freight, and repair expenses.
* Provides leadership and training to accomplish the company goals and objectives.
* Incorporates shop floor organization and plant cleanliness among plant personnel.
* Schedules and conducts plant communication which focused on key operative measurements and safety topics.
* Onsite contact for government agencies, landlords and various other vendors
* Engages team by overseeing employee relations, coordinates team events, employee performance recognition and rewards.

**SAFETY**

* Strives to improve the plant's safety accident record year after year in creating a positive safety culture for all employees. Conducts safety walks of the facility on a weekly basis.

* Monitors the activities of all employees and provides feedback and discipline to promote a safe workplace.
* Oversee the development and organization of all safety related documentation.
* Ensures and develops all required safety related training and promotes programs to lead safe behaviors.
* Audits equipment and the shop floor for safety related improvements.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Supervise plant staff and ensure employee safety.
* Mentor staff to create a productive and positive work environment.
* Accountable to Establish strong relationships that foster engaging collaborative influence.

Requirements:

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Mechanically Inclined.
* Problem Solver.
* Team Oriented.

**EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor's degree in related field or five years plant/general management experience in a manufacturing environment, strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of budgets and financial statements.
* Background with manufacturing methods, process improvement programs and procedures required.
* Basic computer experience with Microsoft Word and Excel
* The military equivalent will be recognized in lieu of education and/or experience.

**MATHEMATICAL SKILLS**

* Basic mathematical skills, addition, subtraction, multiplication and converting fractions into decimals.
* Ability to read a tape measure, micrometer, and caliper accurately.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

* Manufacturing facility exposed to heat and cold.
* Personal Protective Equipment is always required.
* Controlled Noise exposure
* Activity level is high-continuous movement.

**CLARKDIETRICH BENEFITS INCLUDE**

* Full benefits package (Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible Spending Accounts and Life Insurance)
* 401(k) with company match
* Annual Incentive Program
* Paid Time Off
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Paid Community Service Day

Pay Transparency ClarkDietrich’s compensation program supports the company’s Vision and Values. We offer a competitive compensation, opportunities for advancement and a work-life balance.
